note: STRUCTURE SKELETONS (rebuild-plan Phase B, layer 2). Each = a SlideStructure: a grid + ordered NAMED SLOTS that each take a primitive (primitives.json), plus a density contract (a skeleton with an empty required slot is invalid). Clustered from the ~146 whole-slide composites in block-library.json. Rendered inside SlideFrame (content region 1240x588). Built in batches per component-queue.json; each verified side-by-side vs its exemplar render (G3).

structures.name: Financial statement + numbered commentary
structures.grid: 2-col: table left ~700px | commentary right ~500px, 16px gutter, full 588 height
structures.density: 2 slots, both required; commentary chips key to table rows

structures.name: Cash flow: 3 mini-tables + chart + notes
structures.grid: 2-col: left ~430px stack of 3 mini-tables | right ~780px split chart-over-notes
structures.density: 3 stacked mini-tables + 1 quarterly stacked-bar chart + 1 labelled notes panel; all required

structures.name: Business-plan FCF: 3 multi-year tables + notes
structures.grid: 2-col: left ~720px stack of 3 multi-year tables | right ~490px labelled notes panel
structures.density: 3 stacked multi-year tables + labelled notes; no chart (vs cashflow-dashboard)

structures.name: Bridge / waterfall + drivers commentary
structures.grid: chart band ~330px top (full width) | commentary/driver panel ~230px bottom (full width)
structures.density: 1 waterfall/bridge + a driver/commentary panel; both required

structures.name: Company at-a-glance (KPI + narrative + financial dashboard)
structures.grid: 2-col: left ~430px (KPI grid over narrative panel) | right ~790px (financial chart over a multi-graph dashboard row)
structures.density: 4 slots all required — the canonical company snapshot; never a KPI grid + void

structures.name: Investment highlights (numbered rows)
structures.grid: full-width stack of 4-6 numbered rows; or an arc/photo on the left with rows fanning right

variants.label: rows
variants.note: solid numbered panels + claim + mini-viz per row

variants.label: hero-arc
variants.note: dashed arc from a logo hub, pill rows fan off it

variants.label: hero-arc-photo
variants.note: left photo panel arc-masked, numbered pill rows right

structures.density: 4-6 numbered highlights, each with a claim + supporting visual; demands grounded highlights, not a sparse list

structures.name: Central highlight hub (diamond / 3-pillar)
structures.grid: central hub with radiating pillars/highlights filling the region

variants.label: diamond-hub
variants.note: Torino: solid-yellow diamond centre, grey diamond ring, spoke labels

variants.label: 3-pillar
variants.note: ellipse hub fanning to 3 numbered pillar columns

structures.density: 1 hub + N spoke highlights/pillars; the thesis sits at the centre

structures.name: KPI / chart rail over a full-width panel
structures.grid: top band ~420px = 4 chart columns in a rail; beneath = a full-width panel (KPI/NPS/testimonial or arch+certs)
structures.density: 4 chart columns (each with its own legend) + a full-width supporting panel
